#Requires -Version 7.0
[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.Encoding]::UTF8

Add-Type -AssemblyName PresentationFramework
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Windows.Forms
Add-Type -AssemblyName System.Drawing

$script:TargetPid = $null
$script:TargetName = ""
$script:FocusMode = "gentle"
$script:OriginalPlan = $null
$script:DemotedPids = @()
$script:TimerObj = $null
$script:LogDir = "E:\PowerFocus"
$script:LogFile = Join-Path $script:LogDir "PowerFocus.log"
$script:Whitelist = @('Idle','System','csrss','dwm','explorer','winlogon','lsass','services','svchost','fontdrvhost','conhost','Taskmgr','pwsh','powershell','python','DoubaoWork','llama-server')

function Write-Log {
    param([string]$Level, [string]$Msg)
    try {
        if (-not (Test-Path $script:LogDir)) { New-Item -Path $script:LogDir -ItemType Directory -Force | Out-Null }
        $ts = Get-Date -Format "yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss"
        Add-Content -Path $script:LogFile -Value "$ts [$Level] $Msg" -Encoding UTF8
    } catch { Write-Host "日志写入失败: $_" }
}

function Show-Balloon {
    param([string]$Title, [string]$Msg)
    try {
        if ($script:TrayIcon) { $script:TrayIcon.ShowBalloonTip(3000, $Title, $Msg, [System.Windows.Forms.ToolTipIcon]::Info) }
    } catch {}
}

function Get-ProcList {
    return Get-Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessName -ne 'Idle' -and $_.Id -ne 0 } | ForEach-Object {
        $cpu = 0; try { $cpu = [math]::Round($_.CPU,1) } catch {}
        $mem = [math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64 / 1MB, 1)
        [PSCustomObject]@{ Name=$_.ProcessName; PID=$_.Id; CPU=$cpu; Mem=$mem }
    } | Sort-Object CPU -Descending
}

function Show-ProcPicker {
    $win = New-Object System.Windows.Window
    $win.Title = "选择目标进程"
    $win.Width = 520; $win.Height = 480
    $win.WindowStartupLocation = [System.Windows.WindowStartupLocation]::CenterScreen
    $grid = New-Object System.Windows.Grid
    $grid.RowDefinitions.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Controls.GridLength([double]::NaN)))
    $grid.RowDefinitions.Add((New-Object System.Windows.Controls.GridLength(40.0)))
    $lv = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.ListView
    $lv.VerticalScrollBarVisibility = [System.Windows.Controls.ScrollBarVisibility]::Auto
    foreach ($col in @(@("进程名",160),@("PID",70),@("CPU %",80),@("内存 MB",90))) {
        $c = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.ListViewColumn
        $c.Header = $col[0]; $c.Width = $col[1]
        $lv.Columns.Add($c)
    }
    [System.Windows.Controls.Grid]::SetRow($lv, 0)
    $panel = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.StackPanel
    $panel.Orientation = [System.Windows.Controls.Orientation]::Horizontal
    $txtInput = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.TextBox
    $txtInput.Width = 260; $txtInput.Margin = (New-Object System.Windows.Thickness(5,5,5,5))
    $txtInput.Tag = "默认建议: llama-server"
    $btnRefresh = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.Button
    $btnRefresh.Content = "刷新"; $btnRefresh.Width = 60; $btnRefresh.Margin = (New-Object System.Windows.Thickness(5,5,5,5))
    $btnOk = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.Button
    $btnOk.Content = "确定"; $btnOk.Width = 60; $btnOk.Margin = (New-Object System.Windows.Thickness(5,5,5,5))
    $btnCancel = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.Button
    $btnCancel.Content = "取消"; $btnCancel.Width = 60; $btnCancel.Margin = (New-Object System.Windows.Thickness(5,5,5,5))
    $panel.Children.Add($txtInput); $panel.Children.Add($btnRefresh)
    $panel.Children.Add($btnOk); $panel.Children.Add($btnCancel)
    [System.Windows.Controls.Grid]::SetRow($panel, 1)
    $grid.Children.Add($lv); $grid.Children.Add($panel)
    $win.Content = $grid

    function Refresh-LV {
        $lv.Items.Clear()
        foreach ($p in (Get-ProcList)) {
            $item = New-Object System.Windows.Controls.ListViewItem
            $item.Content = $p.Name; $item.Tag = $p.PID
            $item.SubItems.Add([string]$p.PID)
            $item.SubItems.Add([string]$p.CPU)
            $item.SubItems.Add([string]$p.Mem)
            $lv.Items.Add($item)
        }
    }
    Refresh-LV

    $script:PickResult = $null
    $refreshHandler = { Refresh-LV }
    $btnRefresh.Add_Click($refreshHandler)
    $okHandler = {
        $sel = $lv.SelectedItem
        if ($sel) { $script:PickResult = @{ Name=$sel.Content; PID=[int]$sel.Tag } }
        else {
            $nm = $txtInput.Text.Trim()
            if ($nm) {
                $proc = Get-Process -Name $nm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1
                if ($proc) { $script:PickResult = @{ Name=$proc.ProcessName; PID=$proc.Id } }
                else { [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show("未找到进程: $nm", "提示") ; return }
            } else { [System.Windows.MessageBox]::Show("请选择或输入进程名", "提示"); return }
        }
        $win.Close()
    }
    $btnOk.Add_Click($okHandler)
    $cancelHandler = { $win.Close() }
    $btnCancel.Add_Click($cancelHandler)

    $win.ShowDialog() | Out-Null
    return $script:PickResult
}

function Start-GentleFocus {
    param([int]$Pid, [string]$Name)
    try {
        $proc = Get-Process -Id $Pid -ErrorAction Stop
        $proc.PriorityClass = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::High
        Write-Log "INFO" "温和聚焦: $Name (PID $Pid) 优先级设为 High"
        Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "已对 $Name 执行温和聚焦"
    } catch {
        Write-Log "ERROR" "设置优先级失败: $_"
        Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "设置优先级失败: $_"
    }
    try {
        $cur = (powercfg /getactivescheme).Trim()
        $script:OriginalPlan = $cur
        powercfg /setactive 8c5e7fda-e8bf-4a96-9a85-a6e23a8c635c | Out-Null
        Write-Log "INFO" "电源计划已切换为高性能 (原: $cur)"
    } catch {
        Write-Log "WARN" "电源计划切换失败: $_"
    }
}

function Start-AggressiveFocus {
    param([int]$Pid, [string]$Name)
    Start-GentleFocus -Pid $Pid -Name $Name
    try {
        $script:DemotedPids = @()
        foreach ($p in (Get-Process)) {
            if ($p.Id -eq $Pid) { continue }
            if ($script:Whitelist -contains $p.ProcessName) { continue }
            try {
                $p.PriorityClass = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::BelowNormal
                $script:DemotedPids += $p.Id
            } catch {}
        }
        Write-Log "INFO" "激进聚焦: 已降级 $($script:DemotedPids.Count) 个非白名单进程"
    } catch {
        Write-Log "ERROR" "激进聚焦降级失败: $_"
    }
}

function Start-Watchdog {
    param([int]$Pid, [string]$Name)
    Stop-Watchdog
    $script:TimerObj = New-Object System.Timers.Timer
    $script:TimerObj.Interval = 10000
    $action = [System.Threading.Timer]::new({
        param($src, $e)
        try {
            $proc = Get-Process -Id $Pid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
            if (-not $proc) {
                Write-Log "WARN" "目标进程 $Name (PID $Pid) 已退出，自动解除聚焦"
                Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "目标进程 $Name 已退出，已自动解除聚焦"
                Stop-Focus
                return
            }
            if ($proc.PriorityClass -ne [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::High) {
                try {
                    $proc.PriorityClass = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::High
                    Write-Log "INFO" "监管: $Name 优先级被降级，已拉回 High"
                } catch {}
            }
        } catch {
            Write-Log "ERROR" "监管异常: $_"
        }
    }, $null, [System.TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(5), [System.TimeSpan]::FromSeconds(10))
    $script:TimerObj.Dispose()
    $script:TimerObj = $action
}

function Stop-Watchdog {
    if ($script:TimerObj) {
        try { $script:TimerObj.Dispose(); $script:TimerObj = $null } catch {}
    }
}

function Stop-Focus {
    try {
        Stop-Watchdog
        if ($script:OriginalPlan) {
            powercfg /setactive $script:OriginalPlan 2>$null | Out-Null
            Write-Log "INFO" "电源计划已恢复为 $script:OriginalPlan"
            $script:OriginalPlan = $null
        }
        foreach ($dp in $script:DemotedPids) {
            try { (Get-Process -Id $dp -ErrorAction Stop).PriorityClass = [System.Diagnostics.ProcessPriorityClass]::Normal } catch {}
        }
        if ($script:DemotedPids.Count -gt 0) { Write-Log "INFO" "已恢复 $($script:DemotedPids.Count) 个进程优先级为 Normal" }
        $script:DemotedPids = @()
        $script:TargetPid = $null; $script:TargetName = ""
        Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "聚焦已解除，系统恢复正常"
    } catch {
        Write-Log "ERROR" "解除聚焦异常: $_"
        Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "解除聚焦时出错: $_"
    }
}

function Toggle-Autostart {
    try {
        $task = Get-ScheduledTask -TaskName "PowerFocusAuto" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if ($task) {
            Unregister-ScheduledTask -TaskName "PowerFocusAuto" -Confirm:$false
            Write-Log "INFO" "开机自启已关闭"
            Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "开机自启已关闭"
        } else {
            $scriptPath = (Get-Process -Id $PID).Path
            if (-not $scriptPath) { $scriptPath = Join-Path (Split-Path $MyInvocation.MyCommand.Path) "PowerFocus.ps1" }
            $argList = "-NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File `"$scriptPath`""
            schtasks /Create /TN "PowerFocusAuto" /TR "pwsh.exe $argList" /SC ONLOGON /RL HIGHEST /F | Out-Null
            Write-Log "INFO" "开机自启已开启"
            Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "开机自启已开启"
        }
    } catch {
        Write-Log "ERROR" "自启切换失败: $_"
        Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "自启切换失败: $_"
    }
}

function Open-Log {
    try {
        if (Test-Path $script:LogFile) { Start-Process notepad.exe -ArgumentList "`"$script:LogFile`"" }
        else { Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "日志文件尚不存在" }
    } catch { Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "打开日志失败: $_" }
}

# === 托盘初始化 ===
$tray = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.NotifyIcon
$tray.Icon = [System.Drawing.SystemIcons]::Shield
$tray.Text = "PowerFocus - 算力聚焦工具"
$tray.Visible = $true
$script:TrayIcon = $tray

$menu = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ContextMenuStrip

$miSelect = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miSelect.Text = "选择目标进程"
$miSelect.Add_Click({
    try {
        $result = Show-ProcPicker
        if ($result) {
            $script:TargetPid = $result.PID; $script:TargetName = $result.Name
            Write-Log "INFO" "已选定目标进程: $($result.Name) (PID $($result.PID))"
            Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "目标: $($result.Name)"
        }
    } catch { Write-Log "ERROR" "选择进程失败: $_"; Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "操作失败: $_" }
})

$miStart = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miStart.Text = "开始聚焦"
$miStart.Add_Click({
    try {
        if (-not $script:TargetPid) { Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "请先选择目标进程"; return }
        $proc = Get-Process -Id $script:TargetPid -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
        if (-not $proc) { Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "目标进程不存在，请重新选择"; return }
        if ($script:FocusMode -eq "gentle") { Start-GentleFocus -Pid $script:TargetPid -Name $script:TargetName }
        else { Start-AggressiveFocus -Pid $script:TargetPid -Name $script:TargetName }
        Start-Watchdog -Pid $script:TargetPid -Name $script:TargetName
        Write-Log "INFO" "聚焦已启动 (模式: $($script:FocusMode))"
    } catch { Write-Log "ERROR" "启动聚焦失败: $_"; Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "启动聚焦失败: $_" }
})

$miStop = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miStop.Text = "解除聚焦"
$miStop.Add_Click({ Stop-Focus })

$miToggle = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miToggle.Text = "聚焦强度: 温和"
$miToggle.Add_Click({
    if ($script:FocusMode -eq "gentle") { $script:FocusMode = "aggressive"; $miToggle.Text = "聚焦强度: 激进" }
    else { $script:FocusMode = "gentle"; $miToggle.Text = "聚焦强度: 温和" }
    Write-Log "INFO" "聚焦强度切换为 $($script:FocusMode)"
    Show-Balloon "PowerFocus" "当前模式: $(if($script:FocusMode -eq 'gentle'){'温和'}else{'激进'})"
})

$miLog = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miLog.Text = "打开日志"
$miLog.Add_Click({ Open-Log })

$miAuto = New-Object System.Windows.Forms.ToolStripMenuItem
$miAuto.Text = "开机自启: 关"
$miAuto.Add
